title: WebSocket transport
summary: An ordered reliable text transport without flight or session implementation imports.

blocks.text: Provides net.websocket@1.0.0 and a transport contribution; no required services. Browser, offline and Node environments. Network tier; no authoritative persistence or migration. Native WebSocket support is required when connecting, not when importing the package.

The module owns URL normalization, connection timeout, cancellation, text-length validation and connection cleanup. It has no ship, planet, renderer or UI dependency. Existing 6464 /ws defaults and the received text limit are preserved; session semantics belong to a compatible adapter.

A signal cancels pending connections and closes established links. Disposing the provider cancels pending requests and closes its links. Optional removal leaves local play intact; required consumers must select a compatible transport before activation.
Build, export, unpack, edit and rebuild through module:build. Imported code requires explicit consent. Sharing a transport does not establish compatible commands, snapshots, saves or replay.
